coverage.evidence: dashboard/src/layouts/dashboard/settingsNavigation.ts:83-87 puts Trust policy and Escalation in settings.access, labeled Access at frame.group.settings.access in dashboard/src/i18n/locales/en.json; ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:261-262 (moderation:escalation:read Mod, write LeadModerator) and :413-414 (trust:policy:read Mod, manage Broadcaster) with the role ladder Mod 10 < LeadModerator 20 < Editor 30 < Broadcaster 40 at :51-54; TrustPolicyView.vue:34,123-135,147 and EscalationView.vue canManage plus the actions slot hide Save and Reset to defaults and wrap the panels in ReadOnlyScope; TrustGroupPanel.vue:43-44,61 shows Total {sum} of 1 and Default {value}, and the reputationBoostEnabled SettingRow at :48-53 has no hint

ModerationEscalationService.cs:105-110 picks the highest AtOffense at or below the new count, falls back to ladder[0], and gives a timeout step with no length the DefaultTimeoutSeconds; :136-164 adds 1 inside the window and resets to 1 with a new WindowStartedAt after it; :277-306 requires strictly ascending steps; EscalationPolicyDefaults.cs ladder (1 warn, 2 to 5 timeouts of 60/600/3600/86400 s, 6 ban), OffenseWindowHours 168, Max 8760, DefaultTimeoutSeconds 600, MaxTimeoutSeconds 1209600, MaxLadderSteps 50; EscalationDtos.cs:68-75 sets the minimums to 1; escalationDraft.ts:76-94 (new step is last+1 and warn; timeout fills the default); LadderPanel.vue:55-56,130-147 (Add step disabled at the maximum, the Remove step delete control hidden at one step); formatCountdown.ts:33-43 parseClock (m:ss or a bare number in minutes)

EscalationPolicyDefaults.cs IsEnabled=false and CountAutoModViolations=false; ModerationEscalationService.cs:42-46 fails when the ladder is disabled and :222-227 saves the policy without touching ModerationEscalationStates, so counts are kept; ChatFilterExecutionHandler.cs:303-412 always deletes the message first, gives non-Twitch messages the filter timeout, and on a ladder failure falls back to filter.TimeoutSeconds ?? 600; the filter path uses ITwitchModerationApi, which signs with the broadcaster id as moderator_id (TwitchModerationApi.cs:927)

ViolationEscalationService.cs:47-59 needs IsEnabled and CountAutoModViolations; its only callers are AutoModerationHandler.cs:348-370,559-570 (timeout or ban rules, Twitch only, the ladder replaces the rule's punishment) and SpamEnforcementExecutor.cs:106-145 (dry run and flag skipped, non-Twitch through origin, Certain bans directly before the ladder, otherwise the ladder replaces the heat timeout); no manual-action path calls ResolveAndRecordAsync, so held messages and manual actions do not count; ActingModeratorResolverService.cs:66-109 (owner when onboarded, otherwise a member moderator with a Reading chat reader) and BotLifecycleService.cs:368-395 (keeps readers alive for members of enabled, non-onboarded channels)

ModerationProjectionService.cs:54-63 heat deltas, :409-432 builds the TrustContext from User.CreatedAt tenure, BroadcasterType, IsYouTubeChannelVerified and the timeout and ban counts only, :434-443 half-life decay and clamp to 0-100, :448 threshold crossing with a default of 80 at :48; only the ban, timeout and automod_denied handlers feed it (ModerationProjectionHandlers.cs:24-125), so filter_hit and report_validated have no producer; TrustScoreCalculator.cs:38-87 matches the steps, the uncapped NotFollowingFactor because IsFollowing defaults to false, and the 18.75 maximum; TrustPolicyDefaults.cs matches every default in both tables; TrustPolicyValidator.cs:94-190 matches the allowed values; the Trust tier row comes from ViewerProfileService.cs:243-273 -> SpamDefenseService.ResolveTrustTierAsync (:661) -> TrustTierLadder.cs:127-199 (account age, follow, participation, risk, not the trust score), shown at ProfileView.vue:436-441 with labels in locales en.json profile.trustTier and profile.behavior.tier; TrustScoreCalculator.cs:105 GetTier (the Tier ceilings) has no callers

reader_answers.evidence: Heat only flags to the review queue unless AutoTimeoutOnHeat is on (HeatThresholdAutoTimeoutHandler.cs FlagForHumanAsync; ModerationDtos.cs:185-190 HeatTimeoutThreshold 80, AutoTimeoutOnHeat false); step selection is ModerationEscalationService.cs:105-106; the editor controls are in PolicyPanel.vue and LadderPanel.vue

ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:261-262,413-414; TrustPolicyView.vue:34,123; EscalationView.vue canManage; the ladder is off by default and stops at :42-46; a filter ladder step uses the owner-signed ITwitchModerationApi (ChatFilterExecutionHandler.cs:55, TwitchModerationApi.cs:927)

Trust and heat are clamped to 0-100 (ModerationProjectionService.cs:432,440); the tier is separate (TrustTierLadder.cs:127-199; GetTier has no callers at TrustScoreCalculator.cs:105); saving does not reset ModerationEscalationStates (ModerationEscalationService.cs:222-227)

Only a filter escalate rule (ChatFilterExecutionHandler.cs:303-345) or an opted-in AutoMod or spam timeout or ban (ViolationEscalationService.cs:47-59) records an offense; a first offense inserts count 1 (ModerationEscalationService.cs:70-83) and the default ladder warns at 1, times out for 60 s at 2 and bans at 6 inside 168 h (EscalationPolicyDefaults.cs); no code acts on the trust score
